jobs.jobTitle: Senior Full Stack Engineer, Payments Platform
jobs.description: We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to scale our core global payment rails. You will architect high-throughput services using TypeScript, Node.js, and React, backed by PostgreSQL and AWS infrastructure. Experience with distributed systems, REST APIs, and Payment Systems compliance is essential.

Join Anthropic to build resilient computing clusters for foundation model evaluation. Strong proficiency in Python, PyTorch, Kubernetes, and Docker on Cloud infrastructure (AWS and Google Cloud). Deep understanding of Generative AI, RAG Systems, and Technical Leadership required.

jobs.jobTitle: Senior Cloud Architect & Digital Transformation Lead
jobs.description: Lead enterprise clients in cloud migrations and modern microservices architecture. Expert knowledge of AWS, Google Cloud, Kubernetes, CI/CD Pipelines, and Agile & Scrum methodologies. Outstanding Cross-functional Collaboration and Problem Solving abilities.

Architect secure data lakes processing patient analytics. Requires Python, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Machine Learning algorithms, and strict adherence to HIPAA Compliance. Experience deploying RAG Systems and FastAPI endpoints in a hybrid cloud.

Drive the next-generation web performance for millions of merchants. Deep mastery in React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, System Design, and REST APIs. Champion modern frontend development and cross-team Technical Leadership.

jobs.jobTitle: Backend Platform Engineer, High Frequency Ledger
jobs.description: Scale financial reconciliation backends. Proficiency in Go, Python, Redis, and PostgreSQL. Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, and reliable CI/CD Pipelines in AWS environments.

Research and develop prompt steering, tool use, and multi-agent coordination. Extensive experience with Python, PyTorch, Generative AI, RAG Systems, and Machine Learning. Strong track record of technical Problem Solving.

Ensure 99.999% uptime during peak holiday shopping surges. You will automate Kubernetes clusters, AWS cloud topology, Docker container orchestration, and CI/CD Pipelines. Deep experience with System Design and Go.

Advise C-level executives on modernizing legacy technology stacks and moving away from On-premise Virtualization to AWS and Google Cloud. Lead Agile & Scrum teams, provide Technical Leadership, and navigate legacy migrations from Legacy PHP.

Integrate hospital EHR systems with our cloud APIs. Requires REST APIs, PostgreSQL, Docker, HIPAA Compliance, and strong Cross-functional Collaboration. Working with legacy modules previously built in AngularJS (1.x) to migrate them to modern React.

aiInsights.description: Over 82% of machine learning listings analyzed require concurrent proficiency in model training (PyTorch) and production container lifecycle management (Kubernetes, Docker, Cloud). The traditional divide between ML modeling and DevOps has consolidated.
actionableRecommendations: Standardize job families into "AI Platform Engineer" to reflect this blended discipline.
Ensure onboarding includes live access to container registries and evaluation clusters from Day 1.

aiInsights.title: Workforce Upskilling: Building Internal RAG & Prompt Engineering Capabilities
aiInsights.description: Retaining and upskilling existing software engineers in retrieval-augmented architectures saves organizations an estimated $32,000 per seat compared to external recruitment agency fees.
actionableRecommendations: Implement structured 4-week internal workshops centered on vector search, prompt steering, and evaluation datasets.
Recognize and promote internal engineers who contribute AI productivity tools to company repositories.

aiInsights.title: Recruitment Advisory: Full-Stack Architecture + AI Prototyping Premium
aiInsights.description: Job descriptions that pair TypeScript and Next.js frontend fluency with backend Python / AI inference pipelines show a 1.3x higher compensation band and extended vacancy periods.
actionableRecommendations: Compress interview loops to under 10 business days for full-stack candidates with demonstrated AI portfolio projects.
Use real-world system design discussions instead of generic algorithmic whiteboard puzzles.

aiInsights.title: Financial Services & Healthcare Aggressively Adopting Container Orchestration
aiInsights.description: Postings in highly-regulated verticals show a 42% uptick in Kubernetes, Docker, and AWS mandates, accompanied by strict compliance validation (HIPAA / SOC2 / PCI-DSS). Cloud modernization is no longer restricted to pure-play tech startups.
actionableRecommendations: Partner with compliance engineering leads to design role-specific DevSecOps interview rubrics.
Sponsor cloud security certifications (AWS Security Specialty, CKA) for existing infrastructure staff.

aiInsights.title: Rapid Sunsetting of Legacy Stacks

actionableRecommendations: Eliminate outdated framework prerequisites from standard job templates to widen candidate funnels.
Offer transition sabbaticals or structured upskilling for internal teams maintaining deprecated systems.

actionableRecommendations: Consider splitting unicorn role descriptions into focused specialists or offer tailored remote compensation incentives.
